wood-framing.title: Wood Framing
wood-framing.description1: At Golden Rooster Construction, we specialize in professional wood framing for both residential and commercial projects. Whether you're building a new home, a multi-unit development, or a commercial facility, our skilled framing crews deliver precise, code-compliant structures built to last.
wood-framing.description2: We work closely with contractors, developers, and homeowners from the earliest stages of construction — ensuring every wall, floor system, and roof structure is framed with accuracy, efficiency, and craftsmanship. From simple single-family homes to complex commercial builds, Golden Rooster has the experience and manpower to get your project framed right, on time, and within budget.
features: Commercial wood framing (offices, retail, warehouses, multi-family)

metal-roofing.title: Metal Roofing — Repair & Remodeling
metal-roofing.description1: A damaged or aging roof is more than an inconvenience — it's a risk to your entire property. Golden Rooster's metal roofing team provides expert repair and remodeling services for both residential and commercial buildings, restoring the integrity, performance, and appearance of your roof with quality materials and proven techniques.
metal-roofing.description2: Whether you're dealing with leaks, storm damage, worn panels, or simply looking to upgrade to a more durable and energy-efficient metal roofing system, Golden Rooster brings the skills and attention to detail your property deserves.

dry-wall.title: Dry Wall
dry-wall.description1: Golden Rooster Construction provides professional drywall installation services for residential and commercial projects. From new construction to renovation work, our skilled crews deliver smooth, code-compliant finishes that serve as the perfect foundation for any interior space.
dry-wall.description2: We handle everything from framing to finishing — taping, mudding, sanding, and texturing — ensuring every wall and ceiling meets your exact specifications. Whether you need fire-rated assemblies, moisture-resistant board, or standard drywall, we bring the right materials and the right technique every time.

remodeling.title: Remodeling
remodeling.description1: Transform your space with Golden Rooster's full-service remodeling solutions. Whether you're updating a kitchen, renovating a bathroom, or overhauling a commercial interior, our experienced team brings creativity, craftsmanship, and precision to every remodeling project.
remodeling.description2: We manage every stage of the remodeling process — from initial planning and demolition to framing, finishing, and final inspection — ensuring minimal disruption and maximum results. Our goal is to deliver a space that exceeds your vision, within your budget and on schedule.

steel-frame.title: Steel Frame
steel-frame.description1: Golden Rooster Construction delivers precision steel frame construction for commercial, industrial, and multi-family projects. Our steel framing systems provide superior strength, dimensional stability, and design flexibility — making them the preferred choice for demanding construction applications.
steel-frame.description2: From light-gauge steel framing for interior partitions to structural steel systems for large commercial buildings, our crews are trained in the latest steel construction techniques and code requirements. We work efficiently to meet tight schedules without compromising structural integrity.

roofing.title: Roofing
roofing.description1: Golden Rooster Construction provides comprehensive roofing services for residential and commercial properties across Colorado, Wyoming, Nebraska, and California. Our roofing specialists are experienced with a wide range of systems — from asphalt shingles to metal panels — delivering installations built to withstand the elements for decades.
roofing.description2: We approach every roofing project with attention to detail, quality materials, and proven installation methods. Whether you're building new, replacing an aging roof, or dealing with storm damage, our team delivers lasting protection and peace of mind on every job.

siding.title: Siding
siding.description1: Protect and beautify your building with professional siding installation from Golden Rooster Construction. We install a full range of exterior siding systems designed to enhance curb appeal, improve energy efficiency, and provide long-lasting weather protection for both residential and commercial properties.
siding.description2: Our siding crews are experienced with multiple materials and profiles — from vinyl and fiber cement to metal panel systems — ensuring a precise, clean installation that complements your building's architecture and meets local code requirements.

about.heroSubtitle: We started with a pickup truck and a commitment to quality. Today, we're the region's most trusted metal roofing specialists.

story.title: 25 Years of
story.p1: Golden Rooster Construction was founded in Brighton, CO with an unwavering belief that quality and integrity should never be compromised. Starting with just a pickup truck and a passion for precision, we built the company project by project, state by state.
story.p2: Today, we're proud to be one of the most trusted names in construction across Colorado, Wyoming, Nebraska, and California. Our team of 50+ certified craftsmen brings the same dedication to every single job — whether it's a residential remodel or a large-scale commercial build.
story.p3: What sets us apart isn't just our technical expertise — it's the culture of accountability and pride we've cultivated over 25 years. When you work with Golden Rooster, you're not hiring a contractor. You're gaining a long-term partner invested in the success of your project.

milestones.event: Founded in Brighton, CO with a 3-person team and a commitment to quality.
Expanded into commercial roofing, landing our first 50,000 sq ft project.
Opened a state-of-the-art fabrication facility serving the Gulf Coast region.
Reached 2,000+ completed projects and 50+ full-time skilled craftsmen.
Trusted construction leaders serving Colorado, Wyoming, Nebraska, and California.

values.title: Our Core
values.subtitle: The principles that guide every decision, every project, and every relationship we build.

items.title: Quality Without Compromise
items.description: We hold ourselves to the highest standards of craftsmanship in every wood frame we build and every metal roof we install. Quality is not the exception — it is the foundation of everything we do.

items.title: Integrity & Honesty
items.description: We operate with full transparency in our estimates, timelines, and communication. Our clients can always count on us to be straightforward, accountable, and dependable — from the first conversation to the final nail.

items.title: Safety First
items.description: The well-being of our team and the people who will live and work in the structures we build is our top priority. We follow strict safety protocols on every job site, without exception.

items.title: Client Partnership
items.description: We don't just complete projects — we build relationships. We listen, collaborate, and work alongside our clients to ensure their goals are met and their investment is protected.

items.title: Excellence in Execution
items.description: We take pride in getting the job done right the first time. Through skilled labor, careful planning, and attention to detail, we deliver results that speak for themselves.

items.title: Growth & Innovation
items.description: As a growing company, we are committed to continuous improvement — embracing new techniques, materials, and industry best practices to better serve our clients and strengthen our team.
